summary: Stride, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 4, 2026, reporting quarterly and full-year results and disclosing an extension of its existing stock repurchase program from October 31, 2026 to October 31, 2027. The program retains $311.3 million in remaining availability for open-market or negotiated repurchases. No specific price, timing, or commitment was stated, and the program is discretionary. This is a routine capital-return update, not a tender or other special situation, though the extended buyback signals ongoing shareholder return emphasis. Watch for future repurchase activity and any capital allocation changes.
